name: germline-variant-calling
description: Call germline SNVs and indels from a single sample or joint-called cohort. GATK HaplotypeCaller operates in three phases: active region detection (identify areas with evidence of variation), local assembly (de Bruijn graph of reads in active region), and genotyping (pair-HMM likelihood calculation for each haplotype). For single samples, use GVCF mode (-ERC GVCF) to enable later joint genotyping. DeepVariant provides a CNN-based alternative that often outperforms HaplotypeCaller on Illumina data.
